sources.title: Step-3.7-Flash-NVFP4: Open-Source Sparse MoE Vision-Language Model for ...
sources.snippet: Step-3.7-Flash-NVFP4 is a 198B-parameter sparse mixture-of-experts vision-language model from StepFun that activates ~11B parameters per token. It processes images and text natively, supports a 256k context window, and delivers up to 400 tokens/sec throughput. The NVFP4 variant uses aggressive 4-bit quantization for lower memory footprint.
